description:
Born from the fusion of two benchmark frames: the speed of Erakle Air and the climbing lightness of SL7. SL AIR PRO inherits the best of both in a single racing frame, built to hold speed on the flats and respond instantly when the road climbs. The very frame that carried Team Biesse-Carrera-Premac to victory. 797 grams of pure responsiveness.

Every SL AirPro finish is born with a clear purpose. No palettes, no trends—just distinct personalities, each designed for its own terrain. Choose the one that reflects yours.

The standard colorways are just the beginning, never the limit. Colors, finishes, graphic details: together we’ll create an SL AIR PRO that carries only your name.

Crafted from aerospace-grade graphite fiber and vacuum molding free from structural imperfections, SL AirPro eliminates turbulence, removes every unnecessary gram and transforms every surge of power into pure acceleration.

The rear triangle is engineered to transfer every watt into forward motion without sacrificing comfort. The curved seat tube absorbs road vibrations while maintaining maximum drivetrain efficiency, mile after mile.

Integrated carbon handlebar, available in multiple configurations to suit your fit.

Clearance for tires up to 32 mm lets you choose wider rubber for mixed terrain or greater comfort, without ever sacrificing the responsiveness that defines the frame.

Through-Axle disc brakes with Flat Mount calipers, with Quick Release option.

The integrated seatpost clamp reduces aerodynamic drag while keeping the frame’s lines perfectly clean. A technical solution that’s barely visible but felt with every pedal stroke.

From XS to XL, the SL AirPro monocoque frame is engineered to provide every rider with the same balance of aerodynamics and power transfer. If you already know your bike fit measurements, use the Stack and Reach values to identify your ideal size.
